app.name: BewerbungsPilot
app.tagline: Your assistant for job applications in Germany

home.title: Welcome to BewerbungsPilot
home.intro: BewerbungsPilot finds job offers in Germany that fit you, writes your application documents and helps you keep track of every application.
home.nextBody: Start with your profile: upload your CV and answer a few questions. The job search, application packages and sending are being built right now.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.body: A few short steps and BewerbungsPilot is ready for you. First choose the language of the app. You can change it at any time.

claude.title: Connect Claude
claude.intro: BewerbungsPilot uses Claude Code on your computer to read job offers and write your documents.

notInstalled.title: Claude Code is not installed yet
notInstalled.step2: Run the BewerbungsPilot installer again — it installs Claude Code for you.
notInstalled.step3: Start BewerbungsPilot with the desktop shortcut and come back to this step.

notLoggedIn.title: Please sign in to Claude
notLoggedIn.step2: Sign in with your Claude account in the window that opens (a browser page may open too).
notLoggedIn.step3: When you are signed in, close that window and click "Check again".

error.title: Claude did not answer
error.hint: Check your internet connection and click "Check again".

profile.title: Your profile
profile.body: Upload your CV or fill in your details, then answer a few short questions. You can also do this later under "Profile".

email.title: Your email
email.body: Here you will connect your email so BewerbungsPilot can send the applications you approved.

done.title: All set
done.body: The basics are ready. Open the guide at any time to see what comes next.

guide.title: How it works
guide.intro: Seven steps from installation to your next job interview. Steps marked "Coming soon" are not available yet.

install.title: Installation
install.what: The installer puts BewerbungsPilot and Claude Code on your computer and creates a desktop shortcut.
install.todo: Nothing more — you have already done this. Start the app with the desktop shortcut.

profile.title: Profile
profile.what: Your CV, skills and wishes — the basis for every application. Nothing is ever made up.
profile.todo: Upload your CV and answer a few short questions.

email.title: Email
email.what: Applications are sent from your own email address.
email.todo: Enter your email address and a special app password — we show you how to create one in 3 steps.

search.title: Job search
search.what: BewerbungsPilot searches the job board of the Federal Employment Agency and picks offers that fit your profile. You can also paste an offer you found yourself.
search.todo: Click "Search now" or switch on the daily search.

review.title: Review and approve
review.what: For every fitting offer you get a cover letter, a tailored CV, notes about the company and interview tips.
review.todo: Read the documents, change what you like and approve the application.

send.title: Sending
send.what: Only the applications you approved are sent — never anything else.

statuses.title: Track your applications
statuses.what: See at a glance where you applied, who answered and how your applications are going.
statuses.todo: Mark replies such as an invitation or a rejection — BewerbungsPilot helps you answer.

info.languageSwitcher: Changes the language of the app. Documents for employers use the language of the job offer.
info.claudeTest: Sends a short test question to Claude to check that everything works.
info.restartIntro: Shows the welcome steps again. Your data stays as it is.
info.quit: Stops BewerbungsPilot on this computer. Start it again with the desktop shortcut.
info.profileConfirm: Click when you have checked every field of this section. Only checked sections are used for applications.
info.profileCv: Your CV stays on this computer. Claude only reads it to fill in your profile. Nothing is made up.
info.profileAsk: Claude only asks — it never makes anything up. Your answers become stories that you check and can change.
info.profileDocs: PDF files up to 10 MB each, at most 20. Ticked documents are attached to every application automatically.

quit.title: BewerbungsPilot has been closed
quit.body: You can close this tab now. To start again, use the BewerbungsPilot shortcut on your desktop.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.ready: Your profile is ready for applications.
profile.notReady: Before BewerbungsPilot can write applications, please check these sections:
profile.noStoriesWarning: You have no checked story yet — cover letters will be more general. Add one under "Stories for cover letters".
profile.doneInOnboarding: Your profile is filled in. You can change it at any time under "Profile".

cv.title: CV
cv.replaceHint: When you upload a new CV, sections you have not checked or changed yet are updated from it. Sections you have already checked or edited are never overwritten: if the new CV says something different there, you choose which version to keep.
cv.proposed: You had already checked or edited these sections, so nothing was changed there. The new CV has a different version — please choose which one to keep: {{sections}}
cv.unchanged: The new CV did not change anything in your profile.
cv.reading: Claude is reading your CV… This can take up to 3 minutes.

proposal.title: The new CV has a different version of this section
proposal.intro: Your version stays until you choose. If you take the new version, it replaces this section and you check it again.
proposal.saveFirst: Please save or undo your changes in this section first.
proposal.bannerTitle: The new CV differs in these sections — please choose which version to keep:

start.intro: Your profile is the basis of every application. It stays on this computer.
start.withCvBody: Claude reads it and fills in your profile. Afterwards you check everything.
start.withoutCvBody: Fill in the same sections yourself, step by step.

review.intro: Check each section. Fields marked "AI – please check" were filled in by Claude. When a section is right, click "All correct".

profile.aiHint: Claude filled in this field from your CV. Please check it.
profile.dateHint: For example 2021-05 or 2021. Leave "To" empty if you are still there.
profile.dateInvalid: Please write the date as 2021-05 or 2021.
profile.fixDates: Please correct the dates marked in red first.
profile.fixLines: Please shorten the lists marked in red first.
profile.unsavedHint: Some changes are not saved yet. Please save them or undo them before you go on.
profile.officialHint: Write it exactly as on your certificate or contract — it is never translated.

education.title: Education
education.hint: School, vocational training, studies, courses and certificates.

skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: Tools, programs and abilities you really have.

languages.title: Languages
languages.hint: Every language you speak and how well.

wishes.title: Job wishes
wishes.hint: What kind of job you are looking for. BewerbungsPilot searches with this.

entry.description: What you did (in your own words)

languageLevel.C2: C2 – almost like a native speaker

wishes.jobTitles: Jobs you are looking for (one per line)
wishes.salaryMinEur: Minimum gross salary per year in € (optional)
wishes.notes: Anything else that matters to you (optional)

stories.intro: A good cover letter does not repeat your CV — it tells one or two true stories about what you did. Claude asks a few questions to find them.
stories.askIntro: Claude looks at your profile and asks 3 to 7 short, personal questions.
stories.answerIntro: Answer in any language, in your own words. To skip a question, leave it empty.
stories.title: Title
stories.neverHint: Things that must never appear in an application — one per line (for example a client's name).

files.title: Photo and documents
files.intro: Optional: a photo for your CV and documents to attach, such as certificates or references.
files.photoNone: No photo yet. In Germany a photo is common, but not required.
files.docLabel: Name of the new document (for example "Zeugnis Ausbildung")

CLAUDE_NOT_INSTALLED.hint: Run the BewerbungsPilot installer again — it installs Claude Code for you.

CLAUDE_NOT_LOGGED_IN.message: You are not signed in to Claude.
CLAUDE_NOT_LOGGED_IN.hint: Open Settings and click "Open sign-in window".

LLM_TIMEOUT.message: Claude took too long to answer.
LLM_TIMEOUT.hint: Please try again in a moment.

LLM_BAD_OUTPUT.message: Claude's answer could not be understood.
LLM_BAD_OUTPUT.hint: Please try again. If it keeps happening, restart the app.

LLM_FAILED.message: Claude could not finish the task.
LLM_FAILED.hint: Check your internet connection and try again.

LLM_CANCELLED.hint: Start it again whenever you like.

DATA_WRITE_FAILED.message: Your changes could not be saved.
DATA_WRITE_FAILED.hint: Check that your disk is not full and try again.

FILE_TOO_LARGE.hint: A CV or document may be up to 10 MB, a photo up to 5 MB. Try a smaller file, for example save the PDF again with a lower quality.

FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED.message: This type of file cannot be used here.
FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED.hint: CV: PDF or Word (DOCX). Photo: JPG or PNG. Documents: PDF.

TOO_MANY_FILES.hint: Delete a document you no longer need, then add the new one.

CV_UNREADABLE.message: We could not read any text in this CV.
CV_UNREADABLE.hint: It may be a scan or a photo. Try another file (for example the Word version) or click "Fill in without a CV".

PROFILE_NOT_READY.message: Your profile is not complete yet.
PROFILE_NOT_READY.hint: Open "Profile" and check every section with "All correct".

CONFLICT.message: This was changed in the meantime.
CONFLICT.hint: Please look at it once more and then choose again.

BAD_REQUEST.message: Something in the request was not right.
BAD_REQUEST.hint: Reload the page and try again.

NOT_FOUND.hint: Go back to the home page.

SERVER_UNREACHABLE.hint: Start it again with the shortcut on your desktop.

UNKNOWN.hint: Please try again. If it keeps happening, restart the app.

reasons.cvTooLittleText: The file contains almost no text ({{chars}} characters). It is probably empty, or the text is inside a picture.
reasons.cvNoContent: Claude read the file but found nothing that looks like a CV.
reasons.cvDocxBroken: The file could not be opened as a Word document. It may be damaged or saved in another format.
reasons.fileTypeDetected: The file is actually a {{detected}} file. Allowed here: {{allowed}}.
reasons.tooManyDocuments: You already have {{max}} documents — delete one to add a new one.
reasons.llmTimeout: Claude did not answer within {{seconds}} seconds.
reasons.proposalChanged: The new CV changed again — please look at it once more.
